name: hydro-dmrv
description: The on-chain half of a Hedera Guardian workflow: carbon credits whose supply a contract enforces. DmrvRegistry holds the HTS supply key and mints only with the meter's and a VVB's EIP-712 signatures, and only the tonnes its IMethodology module recomputes (ER = BE − PE − LE); raw readings and reports are on HCS so anyone can re-derive a mint. CreditMarket prices in USD from Chainlink with a Supra fallback and settles through a SaucerSwap pool within 3%; retirement mints an HTS NFT certificate. An MCP server lets agents reproduce, buy and retire with their own wallets. Worked example: hydropower under Verra VMR0017 v1.0 with ACM0002 v22.0.

steps.text: Hydro dMRV composes HCS (raw readings + reports), HTS (credit token and NFT certificates created by the contract), Chainlink + Supra (USD-priced settlement) and a SaucerSwap reserve check around a VMR0017 engine. README.md is the human brief; AGENTS.md is the only agent policy.

sections.title: Try it locally (no Hedera account needed)

steps.label: Deploy stand-ins for HTS, Chainlink, Supra and SaucerSwap, the contracts and demo plants, then mint and list one batch
Start the app (it targets the local chain after a local deploy); fund the burner wallet from the footer and buy on /market
Import its key as the deployer
Generate a meter key per plant (.secrets/, gitignored); a Hedera deploy refuses the public demo keys
Deploy (creates the HTS token and NFT collection, prints Hashscan links)
Monitoring: verify a day of sample data, publish readings and report to HCS and record the period on-chain (issues nothing)
Verification: reproduce the pending records from HCS, publish the VVB's report, write verification-<plant>-<first>-<last>.json
The VVB signs the EIP-712 VerificationStatement on its own machine (VVB_PRIVATE_KEY=… yarn mrv:approve verification-….json)
Relay the signed statement; an approval issues HTS credits into the operator's custody
